controlled_stream_n.principle: Number of controlled tasks evaluated under every arm.

degradation_detected.principle: True when irrelevant random, shuffled, or constant memory underperforms no memory.

honest_verdict.principle: Must start with complete:/complete_/success:/success_ and state whether typed memory shows controlled useful reuse.
honest_verdict.value: complete: typed memory shows controlled useful reuse; aligned_vs_shuffled_delta=1.000000, aligned_vs_no_memory_delta=0.666667, degradation_detected=true, retention_passed=true, rollback_exercised=true, no_model_training

memory_heads_tested.principle: List of typed heads consumed by the controlled stream.

nonparametric_memory_updates.principle: True only when the experiment consumes memory without model training or fine-tuning.

recommended_arc_memory_heads.principle: Typed heads that show controlled useful reuse for ARC patch-synthesis decisions.

queries.mmlu_hidden_state_retired: hidden-state MMLU path should stay retired

retention_check_passed.principle: True when promoted and rolled-back entries remain correctly reusable in the stream.

rollback_policy_exercised.principle: True when a rolled-back entry changes a consumer action to block, quarantine, retire, or no-promote.

tests_run.principle: List of verification commands with pass/fail status.
